summary: The proposed patch adds a hardcoded set of valid ordering lookups, which may not be sufficient or flexible enough.

issues.description: The patch only adds 'isnull' to the set of valid ordering lookups, which may not cover all possible valid lookups. This could lead to functional incompleteness.
The patch special-cases 'isnull' without addressing the underlying issue, which may not resolve the root cause of the problem.
The patch introduces a new attribute 'valid_ordering_lookups' without following the existing naming conventions or patterns in the codebase.
